title: Binary Tree Vertical Order Traversal
description:
Given the `root` of a binary tree, return the vertical order traversal of its nodes' values. (i.e., from top to bottom, column by column).

If two nodes are in the same row and column, the order should be from left to right.

examples.explanation: Nodes ordered vertically left to right.

constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [0, 100].
hints: Use BFS instead of DFS so nodes in the same column are naturally visited in top-to-bottom order.
Assign column 0 to root, col - 1 to left child, and col + 1 to right child.
Track minColumn and maxColumn to output ordered result without sorting map keys.
